messages:
maria-g: Hey @people-ops — planning to move from NY to TX mid-May. Do I need to update anything besides my Workday address? Also curious how WFH stipend and state tax withholding change when I relocate.

people-ops: Congrats! Please update your primary address in Workday AND submit the Location Change form. That triggers payroll/benefits workflows.

maria-g: Who does the pro-rate calc for the WFH stipend if I move midpay-cycle?

payroll-bot: @maria-g payroll will handle pro-rata once people-ops submits the effective date. Expect it to reflect in the next pay cycle.

olivia-tax: FYI TX has no state income tax. Payroll will need your new state withholding if you had NY withholding. Also flag: >120 days remote in another state may create nexus and we need to review with Finance.

maria-g: Move date 2026-05-15. Submitted the Location Change form. Is manager approval required?

samir: Manager ack here. Also heads-up — timezone shift might affect on-call windows, let’s sync.

people-ops: When filling the form choose: "Relocation — domestic", include move date + new address, and preferred shipping address for equipment. Steps we’ll take: 1) update HRIS, 2) notify payroll (withholding + stipend pro-rate), 3) notify benefits/ben team for plan eligibility, 4) notify Finance for nexus watch if needed.

maria-g: Form submitted (https://hr.internal/forms/location-change/1769773334). Attached lease PDF.

payroll-bot: Received. Queueing tasks: update W-4/state withholding, pro-rate WFH stipend, one-time equipment stipend routing. ETA 3 business days.

olivia-tax: Logged Nexus Watch ticket #FIN-4982 for Finance to review state tax filing implications. If you're the only TX employee usually a notice, not immediate registration, but Finance will confirm.

maria-g: Do I need to fill anything for health benefits? Will coverage change?

people-ops: Usually no change for major national plans, but we’ll check carrier rules — we’ll reach out if county/state rules require updates. If premiums change we’ll notify you before the first payroll after move.

samir: Reminder — if you get a relocation reimbursement vs stipend, that has different tax/reporting. People-ops will confirm type in your case.

maria-g: Great, thanks! I’ll update my calendar and ping @samir to adjust 1:1 time. :slightly_smiling_face:
